points: The line from the first man is set down in order: Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jered, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, and the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Japheth are named: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Gomer and the sons of Javan are set down after him, tracing the nations that came out of Japheth.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Ham are named: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan, and the sons that came from them.
The line of Cush is traced through to Nimrod, and the sons of Mizraim and of Canaan are listed with the peoples that came from them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Shem are named: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram, and the sons that came after them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The line runs through Arphaxad, Shelah, and Eber, in whose days the earth was divided, and on through Joktan and his sons.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The chosen line is set down plainly: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, who is Abraham.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Abraham are named, Isaac and Ishmael, and then the twelve sons of Ishmael are set down in order.
The generations of Ishmael are listed before the record returns to the promised seed through Isaac.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine, are named, and the sons and grandsons that came from them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: Abraham begat Isaac, and the sons of Isaac are named, Esau and Israel.
The sons of Esau and the sons that came from them are set down before the record of the dukes of Edom.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Seir and their descendants are listed, the people who dwelt in the land before Edom.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over Israel are named in order.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The dukes of Edom are set down to close the chapter, completing the record of the generations from Adam to Edom.
